met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over Southeast Pakistan & neighbourhood persisted over same region at 1730 hrs IST of today 15 September, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through centre of Low Pressure Area over Southeast Pakistan & neighbourhood, Jodhpur, Banasthali Vidyapith, Shivpuri, Sidhi, Ranchi & Digha and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
A trough runs from Bihar to North Odisha across Jharkhand between 1.5 to 4.5 km above mean level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining North Odisha & West Bengal coasts lies over south Odisha and adjoining north Andhra Pradesh and Northwest Bay of Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from South interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance now seen as cyclonic circulation over Jammu & neighbourhoodat 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
